title: Implants from Roger Leir's surgeries, one sending a radio signal

tellings.quote: from the surgeries he did. And we found one that was remarkable. when it was in C2 in the person's neck, it was emitting an a radio signal.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has met aliens, says that in the 1990s he looked at objects taken out of people by a doctor named Roger Leir, who did surgeries to remove them. Strieber says one was remarkable: while it sat at the C2 vertebra in a person's neck, the second bone of the spine, "it was emitting a radio signal," which would suggest a working device rather than a stray fragment.
